name: Nora Etxezarreta
headline: Helping Manufacturers Reduce Costs, Improve Efficiency & Optimize Their Operations | Manufacturing Software
summary:
Manufacturing has always fascinated me — the complexity and the people who make it all work. Growing up surrounded by industry and coming from an engineering background, I never stopped being curious about how things are made and how they can be done better.
Today I work with enterprise manufacturers across Europe, helping them unlock operational performance through software. I partner with my customers, dig into their challenges, and help them find the right path forward.
Every plant is different, every operation has its own constraints and ambitions — and especially these days, with AI reshaping how factories operate and supply chains becoming increasingly complex, empowering people to do their jobs better has never been more important.
I listen before I talk. I ask questions before I propose solutions. I am curious by nature.
If you're a manufacturer looking to improve efficiency, reduce costs, or simply explore what better operations could look like , I'd love to connect.
